description: This file defines models and functions for analyzing and summarizing account analytic data in an Odoo module, including calculations for invoiced amounts, costs, margins, and time summaries, with database view initializations.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Model for analytic accounts with various calculation functions for invoiced amounts, costs, margins, and time tracking.

classes.name: account_analytic_account_summary_user
classes.description: View model summarizing hours by user for analytic accounts.

classes.name: account_analytic_account_summary_month
classes.description: View model summarizing hours by month for analytic accounts.

methods.name: _ca_invoiced_calc
methods.description: Calculates total invoiced amount for analytic accounts and their children.

methods.name: _ca_to_invoice_calc
methods.description: Calculates amount that can be invoiced based on costs and invoice factors.

methods.name: _hours_qtt_non_invoiced_calc
methods.description: Calculates non-invoiced hours for analytic accounts.

methods.name: _hours_quantity_calc
methods.description: Calculates total hours spent on analytic accounts.

methods.name: _total_cost_calc
methods.description: Calculates total costs associated with analytic accounts.

methods.name: _ca_theorical_calc
methods.description: Calculates theoretical revenue based on costs and invoice factors.

methods.name: _last_worked_date_calc
methods.description: Finds the date of the last work done on the account.

methods.name: _last_invoice_date_calc
methods.description: Finds the date of the last invoice created for the account.

methods.name: _last_worked_invoiced_date_calc
methods.description: Finds the date of the last work or cost that was invoiced.

methods.name: _remaining_hours_calc
methods.description: Calculates remaining hours based on maximum hours and hours spent.

methods.name: _hours_qtt_invoiced_calc
methods.description: Calculates hours that have been invoiced.

methods.name: _revenue_per_hour_calc
methods.description: Calculates revenue per hour based on invoiced amount and hours invoiced.

methods.name: _real_margin_rate_calc
methods.description: Calculates the real margin rate percentage.

methods.name: _remaining_ca_calc
methods.description: Calculates remaining revenue based on max amount and invoiced amount.

methods.name: _real_margin_calc
methods.description: Calculates the real margin as invoiced amount minus total cost.

methods.name: _theorical_margin_calc
methods.description: Calculates the theoretical margin as theoretical revenue minus total cost.

methods.name: _month
methods.description: Returns list of months for which data exists for the account.

methods.name: _user
methods.description: Returns list of users associated with the account.

methods.name: _unit_amount
methods.description: Calculates total time spent for summary views.

methods.name: _read_flat
methods.description: Reads data from the database with access rule considerations for account analytic analysis views.
